descriptionEn: While active, ethereal bells periodically appear near you. Your Hits immediately destroy the bells, creating a shockwave that damages nearby enemies and causes a Heavy Stun on enemies that are Primed for Stun. The bells are themselves always Primed for Stun, they can be Culled, and Hits against them are always Critical Hits.
summaryPt: Sinos etéreos aparecem perto de você; acertá-los cria uma onda de choque e Heavy Stun. Os sinos sempre levam crítico e podem ser executados (cargas com Killing Palm/Devour).
wherePt: Concedida pela ascendência Hollow Focus Technique.
